text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
――Gorgeous vernal scenery. 
Spring is the season when the heroes 
yet to be seen are secretly sprouting.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Above all,
this spring may be special.
The Five Hegemons. 
Is it you who will jump out, or…

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Hey! It seems like "That Horse girl" will
finally 
make her first appearance on today mock
race!

The training ground was very crowded that
day. 
A promising newcomer. Yes,
that Horse girl is…

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Burorororo! ! ! 
Twin Turbo, arrive! !

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo is great! Turbo is strong! 
I won't lose to anyone in speed!!
Bagyubagyu～n!!

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text: No, not you!

Everyone retorted at the small horse girl
who 
suddenly jumped out. And from behind…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey everyone! 
I'm the great invincible Teio-sama!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I guess I'll lightly show my talent today.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, here she come! Tokai Teio…!

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
A child prodigy recognized by the 
student council president Symboli
Rudolph… 
I wonder how she will run.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio……. hmmm～,
I feel like I need to do 
something… In that case.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hehen! It's okay!
First I'll see how it goes. 
Turbo will be watching!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Then, all of you trainers, 
watch me, okay? Fufufu～n♪

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ahhhhhh,
the one to watch is Turbo! Listen to me 
Teio! The one named Teio～～～!!!

While attention is focused on Tokai Teio,
one 
person flailing about,
I was a little worried 
about the little Horse girl. and then―

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oops……!
I think I ran a little too slowly. 
But my leg is still warming up!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The real thing starts here! 
Haaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text: Oooohhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaaaaa, what was that!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wow, amazing…… I know she is fast,
but I didn't 
expect her to go that far.

Beside the horse girl who called herself
Twin 
Turbo,
there was another horse girl who seemed 
to be a freshman.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: W… Who?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm a nice nature. You may not know it,
but 
I'm on the same grade as Teio and you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Even so,
there are some who are exceptional, 
after all! It's a feast for the eyes,
thanks for the sight. 
I'm just going to do my best in my own
way…

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Oooooooh!! 
Tokai!! Teio!!!!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
You finally appeared!
A lifelong rival that will make Turbo 
burn everything down!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ehhhhhh, rival you mean…!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I see,
Teio is the sparkling protagonist type, 
and you are the hot-blooded rival type.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Teio!!! Fight with me right now!!!
How about 
another race right now?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Eh, right now!?
Maybe you're not a hot-blooded 
rival type,
but the type that bites right away!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah stop stop! Please calm down Turbo-san!!

Tokai Teio, a promising new star. But,
that 
little horse girl, Twin Turbo,
was completely unfazed.
――And a few days later.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Fufufufufu～n♪

On the wall in front of me… an arrow was
sticking out. 
There was a piece of paper tied to the
arrow. 
I opened it and looked inside――

"Challenge. I'll wait you in the park! ! 
From your lifelong rival"

I didn't know such a place existed.
It might be 
a typo. However, since I received it,
I can't 
just ignore it.

I tried to come,
but no one was there. I can't 
do anything about it,
so I borrowed a fishing rod, 
While fishing at the fishing pond in the
park―

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: It's a duel, Teio! ! !

I caught a horse girl as fierce as a
piranha.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Eh… it's not Teio? 
Ah, that's Turbo's letter…

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me she has been sidetracked
and 
ambushed! Ugh～ turbo doesn't taste good!

Trying to biting me, being frightened… 
she make a lot of reaction. For now 
I try to explain the situation.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I see, so Teio didn't notice Turbo's letter,
and then trainer…

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer is that one right? 
The one who coaches and runs with you!

She doesn't seem to understand it very
well. 
I try explain trainer job in detail.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ehhh～…… so you're going to give lecture? 
Turbo hate it!
I don't like that kind of thing～!

The words that came back were almost
like a 
conditioned reflex.
I try to change the conversation topic.
choice_data_list: Do you want to fight Tokai Teio?
You want to fight Tokai Teio?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
Teio is Turbo's lifelong rival. 
Do you know why I want to win? Do you 
know why I wants to compete with her?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Because I want to win!

It was that simple.
But that's the kind of horse girl she is. 
A carnivorous fish-like horse girl who
instinctively 
finds a partner and challenges them.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
No buts! Turbo will win!
I will show you I can 
win! That's why in the next mock race!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
This time I'll be competing with Teio,
you can 
come and watch!

I promise to her.
Her opponent is the top genius of 
her generation.
I don't know how far she can go, 
but I want to see her struggle.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you can come and watch, 
but promise me one thing!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: No lectures. Turbo hate it.
